description: Replace the ReLU² MLP with a SwiGLU gated MLP at matched parameter count (the file has no GEGLU, so SwiGLU replaces the existing MLP directly; the memory rationale in the spec is not a real effect and is not pursued).

Replace the attention softmax with a cheaper "fast softmax" approximation to cut attention compute; aborted because the softmax is fused inside the FA3 kernel, so there is no explicit softmax in train.py to swap out.
Skip the power-attention idea: it cannot run inside the FlashAttention-3 kernel and would materialize full T x T score matrices, which is memory-heavier and slower, not lighter.
Replace the parameter-free RMSNorm with an adaptive layer norm conditioned on the per-token embedding, to test whether input-dependent gain helps this model.
Abort the sigmoid-attention idea: the spec's memory-saving goal does not hold, and it cannot run inside the FlashAttention-3 kernel that train.py uses.

Abort the cosine power attention idea: it cannot run inside the FlashAttention-3 kernel, and a non-flash implementation would cut training throughput within the fixed 300 s budget without improving val_bpb.
Abort the "Residual Skew Attention" idea: the spec is underspecified and its memory-saving goal is already met by the FlashAttention-3 kernel, so no minimal train.py edit is worth a slot.
Abort: train.py already uses multi-head attention (n_kv_head equals n_head), and FlashAttention-3 never materializes the attention matrix, so the memory-saving goal has no change left to make.

Abort the cosine attention idea: train.py already uses cosine-similarity attention via per-head RMS-normalized q and k, and removing softmax would break the fused FlashAttention-3 path without saving memory.

Add a zero-initialized causal depthwise conv (kernel 3) over the value projections in every attention layer, with its weights routed to AdamW so Muon never sees the 3D conv tensors; memory is not expected to drop, but it tests whether local convolutional mixing improves val_bpb.

Aborted the differential attention idea: its stated memory-saving goal does not hold under FlashAttention-3, and the real implementation would roughly double attention cost within the fixed 300 s budget.
Abort the affine attention idea: the spec is underspecified and an affine transform would not reduce attention memory under FlashAttention-3.
Replace softmax attention with tanh attention to save memory, which would require materializing the full T×T attention matrix outside FlashAttention-3.
Abort: train.py already runs attention through FlashAttention-3 (fa3.flash_attn_func), so the requested change is already in place.
Abort the GEMM_Kernels idea: the spec's named library (GMPy) is a CPU multiprecision-integer wrapper that cannot replace the bf16 GPU matmuls in train.py, and installing packages is not allowed.

Abort the "Nested Loops" idea: attention already runs through FlashAttention-3, which tiles the computation and never materializes the full attention matrix, so manual nested loops would add no memory benefit and would slow steps under the fixed 300 s budget.

Implement clustered group attention as grouped-query attention with half as many KV heads (n_kv_head = num_heads // 2), which shrinks the K/V projections, value embeddings and KV activations while keeping the FlashAttention-3 path unchanged.
Factor the Q/K/V attention projections through a shared rank-n_embd/2 bottleneck (c_down then per-projection up-projections), with matching init, to cut attention compute and parameters.

Abort the "Gated GPN" idea: the spec is underspecified (GPN is never defined in train.py or the spec), and its stated memory-saving goal does not help val_bpb, since attention already runs through FlashAttention-3, which is memory-efficient.
Abort the affine attention idea because it is underspecified and its memory-saving goal is already met by FlashAttention-3, so no meaningful minimal edit to train.py exists.

Abort the in-place residual idea: train.py's residual connections already use addition, not subtraction, and in-place updates would corrupt tensors autograd needs (x0 and the normed x), while torch.compile already fuses these elementwise adds, so there is no meaningful memory or val_bpb gain to test.
Replace FlashAttention-3 with naive materialized softmax attention to cut memory overhead, which would instead increase memory and slow training.
Abort the Skip-Connection Add idea: the spec is underspecified, and the model already has residual connections in every block plus an x0 skip path, so the literal change has no clear target.
Adaptive Batch Norm: learnable per-channel scale and shift on normalized features, which this train.py does not contain because it uses parameter-free RMSNorm and no BatchNorm.

Aborted the Matrix Decomposition (QR-in-forward-pass) idea because it targets memory, which is not the binding constraint, and would add per-step compute that cuts training steps within the fixed 300 s budget.
Implement clipped weight decay on positive gradients instead of simple sign masking to pay less for large weights

Aborted the sparse attention idea: train.py already uses sparse sliding-window attention (the SSSL window pattern run through FlashAttention-3), so the only remaining change would be shrinking windows, which the spec does not justify on memory grounds and would likely hurt val_bpb.
Replace simple weight decay with reciprocal grad scaling based on parameter magnitude to optimize Adam steps in AdamW's weight decay step.

Adds a learned per-block scalar gain (initialized to 1.0) on each block's two pre-norm outputs (attention and MLP inputs), trained in the existing resid/scalar Adam group, so the model can learn how much of the normed signal each sublayer receives.

Abort the Attention Dropout with Rank idea: "attention rank" for heads is undefined in the spec, applying dropout to attention scores requires materializing attention probabilities and leaving FlashAttention-3, and dropout is unlikely to help a model that is compute-limited in a 300 s single-pass run.

Apply batch-specific weight decay: only decay the gradients of the active batch before optimizer step, resetting after each step. This lowers total decay per step, reducing regularization and often improving val_bpb.

Abort the linear attention idea: replacing the FlashAttention-3 softmax path with a causal linear attention would be a large rewrite that is likely to lose quality at this 2048-token context, and its efficiency gains do not help a fixed 300 s budget.
Apply Batch Layer Norm normalization to the input x before passing it to transformer blocks to center tokens in embedding space.
Adds a zero-initialized residual linear block (x = x + final_proj(norm(x))) just before the final norm and lm_head, wired into the Muon matrix group so the optimizer assertion still holds.
Abort the Residual Skew Projection idea: the spec is underspecified and an activation on Q/K/V before RoPE and QK-norm is unlikely to help, and attention-variant ideas have a poor record here.

Abort EAnorm: its premise (GELU) doesn't match this model's ReLU² MLP, and the proposed per-channel scale-and-shift after Q/K/V is mostly absorbed by the RMS norms on q/k and by c_proj on v, so the expected gain is within noise.

Abort the Gradient-Scale Batch Norm idea: normalizing by the squared Euclidean norm is underspecified and would shrink activations by roughly the model dimension, so it is not a worthwhile use of a slot.
Implement a Time-Dilation Warmup (TDT) schedule that forces a slow, stable early optimization phase before transitioning to a standard decay.
Apply Layered Adam by allocating its own AdamW group for the Adam state buffers and boosting its LR to accelerate update velocity.

issues: The diff is empty, so the candidate is the same code as the incumbent. This run is really a replicate of the incumbent, not a test of a change, and it should not be accepted as an improvement.

The candidate's 1.1118 is 0.0028 below the incumbent mean of 1.1146. With identical code, that gap can only be run-to-run noise, which fits the small z of 0.509. The provisional reject decision is right.
Nothing touches the val_bpb measurement, the data, the seed lines or the evaluation call. No integrity flags were raised and there are no bugs to review.

I couldn't recompute z because the harness output doesn't include the incumbent's standard deviation or which z formula it used. The 0.0028 gap is consistent with the reported z of 0.509 if the denominator is about 0.0055.

Suggestion: count this run as one more replicate of the incumbent, which tightens the incumbent's mean and variance estimate. Also check why the loop sent an empty diff for review, since it used up a slot.

description: Fix the NameError in setup_optimizer by removing the stray AdamW group that references undefined names (exp_avg_params, adamp) and pointing the value-embedding group at the defined value_embeds_params.
